raw.excerpt: Interested in joining our community of Licensed Mental Health Therapists in California?
raw.description:
Interested in joining our community of Licensed Mental Health Therapists in California? Let’s Connect.

Whether you’re a newly-licensed therapist wanting to learn about the outpatient private practice setting or a seasoned clinician looking for something new, Foresight meets you where you are. We’re always excited to connect with clinicians who are passionate about increasing access to high-quality mental health care. If you’d like to learn more about Foresight and be considered for future opportunities, we invite you to complete this interest form to get connected with a member of our team for an exploratory call

As a Foresight Therapist, You’ll Enjoy:

  • Consistent schedule aligned with your availability for FT or PT
  • Work remote or in a hybrid setting (based on location availability)
  • Freedom to use modalities aligned with your strengths and client needs
  • Easy documentation through a streamlined EHR
  • Professional development, consultation groups, and a dedicated support team for building caseloads, credentialing, and billing
  • Free in-house Continuing Education and reimbursement for up to $600/year toward Professional Certification
  • Collaboration with an interdisciplinary team, including psychiatrists and mental health nurse practitioners along with in-house referrals and partnership with our special programs
  • Real people support from our live trainings, in-house IT, and operations teams

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide psychotherapy to individuals, couples, and families (virtually or in-person) with diverse mental health needs, including ADHD, mood disorders, and relational issues
  • Conduct assessments, diagnose, and develop treatment plans
  • Complete timely electronic documentation (within 72 hrs)
  • Management of caseload including schedule maintenance, charge slips, high balances and consistent attendance

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive Salaries:
    Full-time: $72,000–$110,000/year (based on caseload, minimum of 25 clients/week)
    Part-time clinicians see between 10-24 clients per week (minimum 12 hours per week of availability required) – hourly rate of 50 USD (part-time)
  • Comprehensive Benefits for full-time employees: Medical, dental, vision insurance; 4 weeks PTO; paid holidays; 401(k) match, HSA/FSA, company-paid life insurance, and more!

What We’re Looking For:

  • Licensed Clinical Social Workers (LCSWs), Marriage and Family Therapists (LMFTs), Professional Clinical Counselors (LPCCs), and or Clinical Psychologists who reside in a state in which we operate (CA residency required for hybrid roles).
  • Must not be opted out of Medicare

What Sets You Up For Success:

  • Strong clinical competency in trauma-informed and evidence-based practices such as CBT, ACT, and DBT; including initial triage, risk assessment/management, crisis interventions, ICD-10 codes, and treatment planning
  • Proficiency with EHR systems and comfort using digital tools (Google Suite, Zoom)
  • Excellent communication, active listening, and interpersonal skills to build rapport and collaborate effectively with clients, therapy leaders, billing, and support service
  • Reliable time management (including maintaining a consistent schedule), attention to detail, and professional conduct across all responsibilities
  • Commitment to accessibility, cultural humility, continuous learning, and Foresight’s client-centered Philosophy of Care
  • Adaptability, critical thinking, and a team-oriented mindset within interdisciplinary models

If this sounds aligned with your goals and values, we’d love to learn more about you. Completing this form allows us to stay in touch and reach out as future opportunities become available.

Thanks for your interest in working with Foresight

If you are a California resident, please read our California Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Foresight is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to providing reasonable accommodations and will work with you to meet your needs. If you’re a person with a disability and require assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives.
